title: About Dr. Gorav Gupta
short: Who Dr. Gupta is, his training and recognition, and why patients choose him.
description: Why choose Dr. Gorav Gupta, and who is he? Training, experience and recognition of a senior psychiatrist in Delhi NCR.

qas.a: Dr. Gorav Gupta is one of the senior consultant psychiatrists in the Delhi NCR region. He holds an M.D. in psychiatry and established Tulasi Healthcare and the Psychiatric Centre at Sector 64, Gurgaon, with grit and determination. He has an extraordinary {{exp}} years of experience in the field of psychiatry in the Delhi NCR region, and in the course of his practice he has successfully resolved many chronic and difficult-to-manage psychiatric cases.

Dr. Gorav Gupta is an eminent psychiatrist with {{exp}} years of experience. He completed his M.B.B.S. at Maulana Azad Medical College (Delhi University) and his M.D. at Lady Hardinge Medical College (Delhi University) in 1997. He is renowned for pioneering super-specialised work in psychosocial rehabilitation in psychiatry. National recognition was accorded for his deep commitment and dedication in developing infrastructure for mentally ill patients, by appointing him as President of the Mental Research Society.

He has been working actively as a consultant and advisor in the areas of mental health and substance abuse for the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and with NITI Aayog. He is an active member of the Central Mental Health Authority and was a panellist who reviewed the Mental Healthcare Act 2017 enacted by the government.
